releaseNotes: 1.1.0: Monitor-only mode - with no restart switch configured, every check result (OK and failed) is written to the forensic event log, and the log buffer grows to 500 entries. 1.0.0: Initial release. Dual-endpoint connectivity checks (captive.apple.com + generate_204, both must fail), timestamped forensic event log, modem power cycle via smart plug with fail threshold, boot grace period, and exponential backoff.
